name: Thaumaturgy
summary: A minor wonder: altered eyes, a booming voice, flickering flames, a slamming door, a phantom sound or tremors.
text: You produce one minor wonder within range (duration up to 1 minute, depending on the effect). If you cast the spell more than once, up to three of its 1-minute effects can be active at a time. Altered Eyes: your eyes change appearance for 1 minute. Booming Voice: for 1 minute your voice is up to three times as loud as normal, and you have Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks. Fire Play: flames flicker, brighten, dim or change color for 1 minute. Invisible Hand: an unlocked door or window instantly flies open or slams shut. Phantom Sound: an instant sound, such as rolling thunder, a raven's cry or ominous whispers, comes from a point of your choice within range. Tremors: harmless tremors shake the ground for 1 minute.
